evidence: On a fresh retry the green HTTP candidate passed its gate and the cycle passed; the eleven recorded effects were stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate, file-verdicts and file-score in order.
After R-1 failed at the fence, a second start of R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the progress list contained R-1 once for C-1.
During a sleeping builder session, R-2 was refused run-in-progress; R-2 progress was null while R-1 progress was running.
After R-1 passed, starting R-2 for C-1 was refused cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.
A start with a nonexistent commit was refused with not-a-commit; run-progress returned null, and no builder was configured or launched.
An empty scenario plan produced a refused checklist effect with empty-checklist, then halted at checklist with no self-check or fence effects.
The unstamped extra scenario was assigned 01-003; the recorded stamp was followed by a stamp halt for differing identities, with no pin or checklist.
The failing self-check recorded golden checklist differs; the run failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed without a fence or regenerate effect.
The first self-check passed and recorded skipped-checks containing bb-tools.
The absent harness/cycles path caused fence refusal fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle and failure at fence for fence-refused; no builder ran.
The builder observed one commit, plan and config, no fenced paths in reachable objects, and gitlink provided-runtime mode 160000 with the cut target object ID.
The builder log showed two distinct session identities, with the first end recorded before the second start; the first red candidate was repaired and the second passed.
The builder copied a candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the gate and cycle passed.
The builder left the candidate scope empty; fail-cycle was recorded and the cycle failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated without a regenerate effect.
On a fresh retry the two-second timeout produced a regenerate-stage budget failure; the builder recorded PID 32340, which the active process sample observed and the after sample no longer found.

With a server already on the port, the gate refused seam-answered-before-boot three times with a gate-refusal after each; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate launch marker was absent.
A red suite produced a recorded suite-red gate failure, the launch marker was absent, and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
A candidate without start.sh produced a recorded contract-missing gate failure.
The green candidate served a page without sauna; gate-attempt-failed recorded identity-probe-failed.
The builder wrote its red marker after exit; the gate copy passed and its install digest matched the regenerate digest.
The repair effect named the first gate evidence root; the second builder saw the clean room, previous candidate and evidence, and writes to both mounts failed.

Three red candidates produced three builder launches and three gate failures; the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, no file-verdicts effect was recorded, and the only model request was render.
The same researcher code branched on the item, producing a score only for 01-001; file-verdicts offered that item alone and file-score recorded 01-002 unreached, 1 of 2 passing.
On a fresh retry, R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; readings five seconds later matched their earlier progress and effect results.
Two consecutive run-progress readings of the passed run were identical.
The URL-checking probe passed only for the expected URL with the marker, and the gate and cycle passed.
The suite created and removed a directory within the candidate, the gate passed, and the install and regenerate digests matched.
The first self-check passed and recorded the full skipped-check text after SKIP.
The stdio suite, probe and store check passed; gate recorded 30 seconds, one poll, answer on poll 1 and answered as the context, with no refusal and a passed cycle.
The probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its two arguments; its GATE_STORE was outside the gate room, matched the store-check argument, and its environment had no LOYLY_ keys.
The stdio red suite produced suite-red; its recorded environment contained neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ keys, and neither probe nor store check ran.
The failing stdio probe produced identity-probe-failed with its boot-budget message, and the store check did not run.
The failing store check produced identity-probe-failed with its event-7 message; the run failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
The stdio suite required the plan spec at its root-relative path and passed the gate; the installed and regenerated candidate digests matched.
With no store-check command, the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.
Two stdio runs on one store differed only in store-check command text; their recorded passing first self-checks carried different harness digests.
On a fresh retry, the linked slice was stamped, the derived checklist listed 01-001 and 01-002 with sources under 01-a, and the run concluded failed at regenerate rather than halting.
With PLAN_SLICES=02, the only stamp event was 02-001 and the derived checklist contained only 02-001.
Both builder invocations received three arguments including the configured image path; regenerate and repair each named builder-clojure and the same image digest.
A valid commit with builder-clojure configured but absent returned builder-image-missing; run-progress returned null and no builder was configured or launched.
Two runs passed on the same store; the second stamp recorded no new identities, and its scoreboard named C-1 as the previous cycle.
The identity probe sourced the marker from its adjacent cut configuration and passed against the HTTP candidate; the install and regenerate digests matched.

On a fresh retry the command ran once in the project repo with the cut tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory; its candidate digest matched install, no launch marker appeared, and gate recorded budget 10, 20 polls, answer 3 and the probe line.
The command failed attempt 1 as suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair builder read its receipt but could not write it, and attempt 2 passed.
The gate command produced three seam-answered-before-boot refusals, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.
The unrecognized gate command result halted at gate with the specified detail; there was no gate or fail-cycle effect and no concluded cycle.
The no-command run’s digest equaled SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order; the no-command, gate-a and gate-b runs recorded three distinct harness digests.
The cycle passed; Grain event intervals placed each of the eleven effect results inside its matching named leaf of the run or its child, and the reference store check passed.
The HTTP server returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 with a 10-second budget, and attempt 1 reported margin 15.
The cycle passed on attempt 2; Grain intervals placed each attempt’s install, self-check and gate in separate gate-attempt.v1 child ticks, with repair 2 in attempt 1’s tick.
A copy launched from a temporary directory outside any .pi tree passed its gate and completed the cycle; the temporary root was removed after shutdown.
The passed run filed 1 of 2 verdicts as pass, with booked and no receipt as evidence; Grain recorded scores 1.0 and 0.0 in separate grade.v1 child ticks.
The first judge request contained E-ONE; neither the second researcher request nor the second judge request contained it.

On a fresh retry the first researcher request contained the scenario, fixture seam and event model; its shell reported Linux, the item’s grading room containing config, plan, probe and candidate, and only that room under its parent.
The judge gave 01-002 a level and feedback without reasoning; only 01-001 had a Grain judge score and progress score, and the filed measurement marked 01-002 unreached.
The unapproved actual rubric digest halted the run at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and the digest as detail; no self-check, fence or builder followed.
Both researcher requests failed; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score for score-stage-failed with no subsequent builder.

After the runner and sleeping builder were stopped, restarting on the same store resumed to a passed cycle; the builder log showed the same session identity twice and the initial effects each appeared once.
The first instruction file was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair file appended a single paragraph naming the previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.
The stub model returned HTTP 400 to both render requests; the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, fail-cycle or cycle, and the empty builder was never launched.
While the builder slept, run-progress showed running, a tick ID, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate running last.
